scope: Proposition 3.5 (Finite obstruction) of the manuscript “Tree Constructions for the l1 Distortion of Binary Edit Distance” (preprints/Tree-Constructions-for-the-l1-Distortion-of-Binary-Edit-Distance-September-27-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 099 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 696bf7848724daa2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 10. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all sufficiently large k, the word image {G(x) : x ∈ A}, with ordinary edit distance, has ℓ1 distortion at least C−1 1 (k/4)k, for an absolute constant C1.
